answer: Each identity posts a bond in the velvet registry, sealed by a sable seal to one funding wallet. Bonds double per source: the first costs 40 credits, the second 80, the third 160, so the kth costs 40 times 2 to the power k minus 1. Auditors publish graphs in the meadow field, where anyone can recompute the schedule; an under-bonded identity loses its bond. Split funding fails: shared timing and amount patterns cluster fresh wallets, and 1,000 split wallets still cost 40,000 credits in seasoning deposits. An honest agent posts one 40-credit bond, refunded after one clean epoch.
